name: test-accelerator
about: presk's test machine (plan 0.18.0 step 5, D208): a matrix unit that multiplies saturating E4M3 values and sums their products in binary16, or multiplies 8-bit integer codes and sums them in a wrapping 32-bit integer, along the summed axis in chunks of 32 terms; a vector unit that computes in binary16.
